description: Create a new Distribution Group associated with the given Project.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Token
parameters.description: Client-generated UUID v4 identifying a create operation. Retrying with the same token returns the original result instead of creating a duplicate.

id.description: Unique identifier for the distribution group.

description.description: Free-text description of the distribution group.

users.description: Active users belonging to the distribution group.

company_name.description: Name of the company the User belongs to.

login.description: Login email address of the User.

imageUrl.description: URL of the User's avatar image.
